reactors.directFlow: On member AccessGrantIssued, reads Member at the exact source membership episode and dispatches cleanup only after an immutable retirement proof; nonmember grants are ignored.

reactors.replayAndFailureContract: Exact receiver-owned source proof and deterministic IDs; retain checkpoint on transient dependency or unknown outcome.

reactors.directFlow: On TeamMemberAssigned, reads Member at the assignment episode. reactors.replayAndFailureContract: Exact receiver-owned source proof and deterministic IDs; retain checkpoint on transient dependency or unknown outcome.
reactors.requiredTests: MemberRetirementRecoveryTests: active assignments dispatch nothing; old exact assignment removed; newer episode preserved; unknown outcome retries; wrong source/position/episode rejected.
